en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand spa‑town building complex. On the left is a multi‑storey hotel with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows; on the right is a neoclassical building with a columned portico and a pediment bearing relief sculpture, labeled "KURTHEATER". In the foreground are manicured gardens, steps, and a curved driveway with a few people and an early automobile. At the bottom edge, printed text identifies the location as Bad Elster and names the buildings Sachsenhof and Kurtheater.
